scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @justdoit/shared && npm run dev -w @justdoit/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @justdoit/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:local: npm run infra:up && npm run dev
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.start:local: npm run infra:up && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build: npm run build -w @justdoit/shared && npm run build -w @justdoit/api && npm run build -w @justdoit/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @justdoit/web && npm run lint -w @justdoit/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @justdoit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @justdoit/api && npm run typecheck -w @justdoit/web
